item.title: Border Crossings Hit Lowest October Ever Recorded, Customs and Border Protection Says
item.description: CBP counted 27,890 encounters nationwide last month, the fewest it has ever logged to start a fiscal year. Border Patrol arrests at the southwest border fell to 8,288.

item.title: Wildlife Agent Shoots Man Who Pointed Gun at Him on Eunice Night-Hunting Call, State Police Say
item.description: Louisiana State Police detectives are investigating Saturday night’s shooting on Chataignier Street. The man was taken to a hospital; no agents were hurt.

item.title: Abbeville Council Tonight: New RV Parks, The Meadows Phase II and Repairs at the Government Building
item.description: The City Council meets at 5:30 p.m. at City Hall. The agenda also includes a December trail ride permit, a state aid request and the final payment on a blight clearance project.

item.title: Trump, Xi and Putin Will Meet Together for the First Time Thursday in China
item.description: China’s Foreign Ministry confirmed the first-ever three-way summit of the U.S., Chinese and Russian leaders for Nov. 19 in Shenzhen. Washington says peace and denuclearization are on the table; Moscow says the agenda is still being written.

item.title: Thanksgiving Week Garbage Pickup Shifts a Day Later in Vermilion Parish
item.description: Waste Connections will skip Thanksgiving Day. Thursday routes run Friday, Friday routes run Saturday, and the regular schedule returns Monday, Nov. 30, the Police Jury says.

item.title: Four Seconds Short: Texas Beats LSU 22-21 on Last-Gasp Touchdown in Death Valley
item.description: The Tigers led most of the night behind two interceptions from safety Ty Benefield, but Arch Manning hit Raleek Brown from 4 yards out with four seconds left. LSU is 6-4 and heads to Tennessee on Saturday.

item.title: One Equipment Swap in Arkansas Shut Down America’s Skies. It Happened 225 Miles From Abbeville.
item.description: A routine change-out of network gear at a remote FAA radio site in El Dorado, Ark., flooded the nation’s air traffic system Friday. Every flight in the country was held on the ground, and the fallout stretched into Sunday.

item.title: Louisiana’s Sen. Cassidy Calls RFK Jr.’s Tenure a ‘Series of Failures’ as the U.S. Loses Its Measles-Free Status
item.description: On national TV Sunday, the doctor-turned-senator urged parents to vaccinate, said he hasn’t decided how he’ll vote on Trump’s FDA pick Wednesday, and blamed a Democrat for stalling his Social Security plan.

item.title: Tanker’s Rudder Jammed Two Minutes Before It Rammed a Docked Riverboat in New Orleans, NTSB Says
item.description: Federal investigators say the Atlantic Asphalt’s steering failed as it passed under the Crescent City Connection Friday, sending it into the American Heritage. Everyone aboard the riverboat was accounted for.

item.title: Wind Advisory for Vermilion Parish Until Noon Monday: Gusts Up to 35 mph
item.description: The National Weather Service warns northeast winds could knock down tree limbs, cause a few power outages and make driving tough for trucks and trailers. Tie down what’s loose tonight.

item.title: The Week Ahead in Vermilion Parish: Council and Police Jury Meet, Kaplan Hosts a Playoff Game, Sammy Kershaw Hits the CMA Red Carpet
item.description: Your guide to Nov. 16-22, from public meetings in Abbeville and online SpaceX hearings to playoff football, the last weekend of “Joseph” and Gueydan’s voter registration deadline.

item.title: SpaceX Catches Starship for the First Time: The Rocket Built to Fly From Pecan Island Comes Home in the Tower’s Arms
item.description: After 22 and a half hours and 14 trips around Earth, Ship 42 dropped back to Starbase, Texas, and was snatched out of the air at about 3:20 p.m. Central Saturday. “We caught a Starship, and now everything changes,” SpaceX said.

item.title: Starship Comes Home Today: SpaceX Will Try the First-Ever Catch of Its Ship at About 3:20 p.m.
item.description: After 14 trips around Earth, Ship 42 is healthy and headed back to Texas, SpaceX says. If the tower’s arms grab it, it would be a first for the rocket built to fly from Pecan Island.

item.title: Kaplan’s Sammy Kershaw Will Walk the CMA Red Carpet Wednesday; His Manager Tells the Times New Music and a Memoir Are Coming
item.description: A week after he was turned away, the “She Don’t Know She’s Beautiful” singer accepted the CMA’s apology and invitation. His manager says he’s also working on new songs, a book and “lots of touring.”

item.title: Delcambre Stuns No. 8 South Plaquemines 19-18 to Advance; Kaplan Gets Vidalia Next Week
item.description: The 25th-seeded Delcambre won by a single point on the road. Erath, North Vermilion and Vermilion Catholic saw their seasons end in the first round, according to the LHSAA’s official brackets.

item.title: SpaceX’s 11th Pecan Island Job: A Safety Manager Who Would Be the Launch Site’s Contact for Local First Responders
item.description: The new listing, posted Friday, puts the hire in charge of safety and environmental programs “at the Starbase, LA launch site,” including spill response, stormwater and air permits, and working with local emergency agencies.

item.title: Today’s the Day: SpaceX Goes for the First Catch of an Entire Starship, the Rocket Built to Fly From Pecan Island
item.description: Liftoff from Texas is set for 4:45 p.m. Central. Minutes later SpaceX will try to snatch the 33-engine booster out of the air with its tower’s arms. Then, after a day in orbit, it wants to do the same with the ship.

item.title: Abbeville’s Downtown Street Project Wins a National Federal Highway Award, the First in a New ‘Putting Families First’ Category
item.description: The Federal Highway Administration named the city’s downtown revival the national winner of its new family-focused innovation award. The prize carries no money, but it puts Abbeville in front of road builders across the country.

item.title: Abbeville Honors Marion Bessard Jr. and Donald Ray Shelvin, the First Black Men to Join Its National Guard Unit
item.description: In 1974 the two Abbeville High students enlisted together in the city’s Louisiana Army National Guard battalion. On Veterans Day, Mayor Anita Levy’s proclamation called them pioneers of the unit’s integration.

item.title: Gueydan Mayor’s Runoff: Online Voter Registration Closes Nov. 21, Early Voting Starts Nov. 28
item.description: Jason Suire and Efrem “Zim” Livingston are the only names on Vermilion Parish’s Dec. 12 ballot, according to the Secretary of State. Here are the dates every Gueydan voter needs.

item.title: SpaceX’s First Big Louisiana Permit Doesn’t Say ‘Launch’: It’s Called the ‘Coastal Infrastructure Improvement Project’
item.description: State records show SpaceX applied in September to build a Gulf wharf at Freshwater City, barge docks, a 15.75-mile heavy-haul road with a 1.5-mile bridge, and to dredge area canals, touching nearly 888 acres of wetlands and water bottoms. Work would run from 2027 to 2032.

item.title: FAA Tells the Times: SpaceX Has Not Applied to Launch Starship From Louisiana
item.description: The federal agency that must approve any launch from Pecan Island says it has no SpaceX application to review yet. Next week’s Starship hearings are about the Texas site only, the FAA said.

item.title: Trump Says the U.S. Doesn’t Need a Deal With Iran: ‘We’ve Got Their Strait.’ Oil Ticks Up as Gulf Coast Gas Prices Fall
item.description: The president’s post on Thursday pushed crude higher for a while after weeks of hopes for a settlement. At the pump, Gulf Coast regular gasoline averaged $3.48 a gallon this week, down 15 cents, but still 88 cents above a year ago.

item.title: Musk: ‘Starbase, Louisiana Will Unlock That Future’
item.description: In a statement the state posted on its SpaceX project page, Elon Musk calls the planned Vermilion Parish spaceport something that “has only existed in science fiction.” Here is his full statement and what the state says will be built.

item.title: State’s Secret SpaceX Plan Listed ‘a New City in Vermilion Parish,’ Records Show
item.description: A March briefing by Louisiana Economic Development, code-named Project Osprey, named a new city among the things needed to win SpaceX. A month later the line was gone. The Times has asked the state what it meant and whether residents would get a say.

item.title: New SpaceX Job Says Starship Will Be Built in Louisiana, With Staff Moving Here in Early 2027
item.description: A director’s listing describes Starship production at the Pecan Island site and says the hire relocates to Louisiana early next year. A second new posting, for a lawyer to win power approvals for SpaceX data centers, is also listed at Pecan Island. That makes 10 openings.

item.title: Abbey Players Open ‘Joseph and the Amazing Technicolor Dreamcoat’ Friday in Downtown Abbeville
item.description: Abbeville’s community theater stages the family musical over two weekends, Nov. 13-22, at its State Street theater. Tickets are $20. Here are the showtimes, the cast and how to get tickets.

item.title: SpaceX Will Try to Catch Both Halves of Starship on Friday, the Rocket It Plans to Fly From Pecan Island
item.description: Starship Flight 15 could launch from Texas as soon as Friday at 4:45 p.m. Central. SpaceX says it would be the first time the booster and the ship both come back to the tower, the kind of reuse a high-rate site like Starbase Louisiana depends on.

item.title: Buc-ee’s Breaks Ground in Lafayette, Its Closest Store to Vermilion Parish, With a February 2028 Target
item.description: The $82 million travel center at I-10 and Louisiana Avenue will have 120 gas pumps, about 700 parking spaces and boudin on the menu. Lafayette’s economic development agency says it will support more than 300 jobs.

item.title: SpaceX Wants Up to 456 Starship Launches a Year From Texas, With Landings in the Gulf. The FAA’s Hearings Are Now Online, and Anyone Can Join
item.description: The FAA moved all five public meetings on SpaceX’s Texas expansion online and gave the public until Dec. 7 to comment. Boosters and ships could come down in the Gulf of America under the plan. Pecan Island is not part of this review.
